documentation.title: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) V4
documentation.locator: Official page description, version links and last-updated line; leaderboard rankings not analyzed
documentation.summary: [SOURCED] The official page distinguishes AST evaluation, contributed functions, multi-turn interaction and V4 agentic evaluation. Its displayed last-update date is 12 April 2026.
documentation.mechanism: [SOURCED] Function invocation evaluation across increasing interaction scope.
documentation.limitation: [INFERENCE] A function-call score cannot alone certify safe end-to-end state recovery.
documentation.project_implication: [INFERENCE] Add schema validity and inappropriate-tool-call cases without equating them to complete reliability.
documentation.nearest_counterevidence: AE001: dual control tests coordination beyond individual calls.

documentation.title: Inspect AI: Framework for Large Language Model Evaluations
documentation.locator: Official documentation: Getting Started; Hello, Inspect; Agent CTF example; Citation
documentation.summary: [SOURCED] Inspect separates dataset, solver and scorer, supports local model providers, and demonstrates sandboxed agent tasks and transcript inspection. This review did not install or run it.
documentation.mechanism: [SOURCED] Composable evaluation contracts and logged solver trajectories.
documentation.limitation: [INFERENCE] A framework does not validate the chosen tasks, scorer or model judgments.
documentation.project_implication: [INFERENCE] Mirror these boundaries in the owned minimal harness; adopt Inspect only when useful.
documentation.nearest_counterevidence: AE011: judges need separate reliability validation even within an evaluation framework.
